locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure, zero extension, and the source-limit normalization
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, retained inside the combined Weil matrix before every pencil, pullback, resolvent, or inertia operation
locked_conventions.complete_matrix: Q=Q_pole+Q_arch+Q_prime is signed bookkeeping: Q_arch and Q_prime already carry their signed source contributions, and Q_prime retains source equation (3.19)'s minus sign
locked_conventions.source_normalization: 4*hat(k_lambda^+) tends to Xi; unit-normalizing h_lambda is rejected
locked_conventions.boundary_normalization: <eta,xi>=1 only after nonvanishing is established; arbitrary ground-line scaling must be tracked explicitly
locked_conventions.finite_status: all pencil, Weyl, and inertia identities are finite-dimensional reductions and are not asymptotic sign or determinant-limit claims

locked_formulas.simple_even_shift: T=Q-epsilon*I=T_+ direct_sum T_-, T_+>=0, ker(T_+)=C*xi, and under a full simple-even ground T_->0
locked_formulas.combined_physical_pullback: F_alpha(y)=C*y direct_sum alpha*y and F_alpha^*T*F_alpha=C^*T_+*C+alpha^2*T_- with alpha=sigma*L/(2*pi)
locked_formulas.effective_dimension: d_eff(alpha)=Tr(alpha^2*(G+alpha^2*I)^(-1))=sigma^2*S_(1,q) for alpha=sigma*L/(2*pi); bounded first trace is exactly d_eff=O(1)
locked_formulas.one_sign_no_go: if all noncentral boundary-normalized ground coefficients have one sign, mathcal_A(g)/mathcal_A(a) is at most max(a/g,1) for 0<g<a and cannot supply reciprocal exponential-in-L compensation
locked_formulas.squared_mode_displacement: [D^2,Q_+]=|D beta><eta|-|eta><D beta| and D_P^2*(P Q H)-(P Q H)*D_H^2=|P D beta><H eta|-|P eta><H D beta|
locked_formulas.middle_graph: for c in C_(M,R), P_M c=tau(c)*x with tau(c)=-<H kappa,Hc>/||x||^2, so P_L Q c=tau(c)*P_L Q x+P_L Q Hc
locked_formulas.odd_resolvent_vectors: u_s=(Q_- -sI)^(-1)Dkappa, v_s=(Q_- -sI)^(-1)beta, Phi_s=(1+<eta,D^dagger v_s>)*V_0-D^dagger v_s, and Psi_s=D^dagger u_s-<eta,D^dagger u_s>*V_0
locked_formulas.ground_alignment: at the simple even ground mu, Phi_mu is the boundary-normalized ground and Omega_(U-mu)^(-1)eta_(U-mu)=-P_L Phi_mu/<kappa,Phi_mu>
locked_formulas.even_ground_factorization: for an even-compression ground x with c=<eta,x>!=0, u=D x/c, d=D eta, K=D*T_+*D^*, X=D_-^2-|u><d|, one has T_-u=-beta and K=T_-X
locked_formulas.imaginary_pair_count: n_-(Q_- -epsilon*I) equals the number with algebraic multiplicity of positive alpha^2 zeros of A_x(alpha), equivalently the number of purely imaginary quotient-root pairs
locked_formulas.odd_sign_equivalence: Q_- -epsilon*I>0 iff A_x(alpha)>0 for every alpha>=0
locked_formulas.pointwise_sufficient_sign: if the boundary-normalized even trigonometric polynomial x/c is pointwise nonnegative and nonzero, then its transform is positive on the whole imaginary axis and Q_- -epsilon*I>0
locked_formulas.finite_axis_tail: for xi=x/c, M_2=2*sum_(n=1)^N n^2*|xi_n|, and alpha>0, A_x(alpha)>=1-M_2/alpha^2; positivity need only be checked through alpha=sqrt(2*M_2)
locked_formulas.shifted_odd_reserve: lambda_min(T_-)>=lambda_min(K)/lambda_max(X)>=g_e*|x_0|^2/lambda_max(X), so U-epsilon<g_e*|x_0|^2/lambda_max(X) is sufficient for Q_- -U*I>0
locked_formulas.n2_imaginary_axis_countermodel: X=(1/3)*[[173,340],[-130,-248]], K=[[269,430],[430,689]], and A_x(alpha)=((alpha^2-9)*(alpha^2-16))/((alpha^2+1)*(alpha^2+4)); A_x is positive on 0<=alpha<3 although the odd inertia is two
locked_formulas.middle_graph_countermodel: Omega_0=2*epsilon/5, ||eta_0||^2=6*epsilon^2/25, and ||Omega_0^(-1)eta_0||^2=3/2 despite vanishing raw low-high coupling, strict signs, perfect far coercivity, and residual tending to zero
